post.description: WH-006. The body holds the rows of nine D1 tables (camelCase columns, values as exported). Every link, before + change = after, the chain of every line and the issued metres are checked; truncated values are refused. The stock is emptied and written in one transaction, revisions are replayed, and every movement and line is compared with the export; any difference rolls back. A dry run rolls back too. Records entered in Brevi itself are removed only with confirmReplace. The same export again changes nothing.

post.summary: Import legacy finance
post.description: «Імпорт архіву Фінансів» (stage 5): finance.json of the old Calculator export (format brevi-finance-v5), as is or gzipped by the browser (told by the gzip signature; unpacked up to 200 MiB). dryRun=true only checks and reports. dryRun=false moves the records with their old ids in one transaction and only when the check has no errors; otherwise the report comes back with applied=false and nothing is written. A record whose id Brevi already has is skipped, so a second run adds only what is missing. Old clients and suppliers used in operations are linked to «Клієнти» by KeepinCRM id and to «Постачальники» by KeepinCRM id or a unique name; unknown ones become finance counterparties. Bank statement previews and files are not moved.

get.summary: «Звіти» (stage 8): active income and expense of the inclusive period, grouped by the kind
get.description: «Звіти» (stage 8): active income and expense of the inclusive period, grouped by the kind. An ExpenseStructure Group row already holds its Subcategory rows. Operations are oldest first, at most 100 rows (limited = more exist, totalRows = all).

It becomes a preview with recognised lines (duplicates, transfers between own accounts, counterparties by ЄДРПОУ, IBAN or name, auto categories); nothing reaches the books until book. get.summary: Get bank statement

A transfer line takes only the note and excluded; an error line and an exact duplicate cannot be included. The bank data never change.

post.summary: Book bank statement
post.description: «Провести виписку»: every included line of states Ready, NeedsCategory and NewCounterparty becomes an operation (source BankImport) and every Transfer line a transfer, in one save, after the exact duplicates are checked again. A line nobody was recognised for creates an unconfirmed finance counterparty (one per ЄДРПОУ, IBAN or name). The statement becomes Booked and no longer changes.

post.summary: Rollback bank statement
post.description: «Відкотити виписку» (stage 7): every active operation and transfer the statement booked is cancelled (Void, kept in the journal and the change log) and gives up its bank identity, so the lines are no duplicates when booked again; a record cancelled by hand before stays as it is. Unconfirmed finance counterparties the booking created are archived when no active operation outside the statement uses them. The statement becomes a Preview again with its lines unlinked. One save.

get.summary: «Операції»: one area, newest first by default (ties: newest saved first)
get.description: «Операції»: one area, newest first by default (ties: newest saved first). post.description: «Анулювати»: never deleted; the operation stays in the journal (includeVoided) and the log but no longer counts. A cancelled operation cannot be changed (400).

get.description: CatalogRead. The server searches, filters, sorts and pages the rows of one type and returns them with their prices, so the list needs this single request. post.description: Requires access:products and an actor (CAT-009). The server picks the ID (largest + 1) and the slug (from the Ukrainian name; the code and then a number are added when it is taken). The name is Ukrainian only. An empty sewing code takes the next free MOD-XXX. The section must belong to the type. A PPE product needs the ppe block; the first price version is appended with source «Створення ЗІЗ». priceSaved is false when the product was saved but its price was not; the card then asks to save the price again.

post.summary: Import all products from the Calculator sheet (preview or apply)
post.description: Requires access:products and an actor (CAT-010). One-time transfer of the tabs «Товари» (with «Прайс на сайт», «Комплектація виробів», «Трудовитрати виробів») and «ЗІЗ». A row matches a stored product by type and code (sewing model ID, PPE site article), else by the exact name of the same type; a matched product keeps its ID and slug, the rest are created (ID largest + 1, slug as in createCatalogProduct). Names are Ukrainian only; the Russian name column gets a copy. A matched sewing model gets its article list and whole composition replaced; the note «Спільна складова для всіх артикулів моделі» that the sheet repeats on shared lines is dropped. A PPE product gets a new offer version (source «Імпорт з таблиці», dated the import day) only when the supplier price, the rule or a given Insight price differs; no supplier price means no version. With deleteMissing, every product of either type that no row matches is deleted. dryRun (default true) never writes. Any problem means nothing is written; warnings (unknown rule imported as none, no supplier price or link) do not stop the import. All writes run in one database transaction.

get.summary: Check a new product code and suggest the next sewing code

post.summary: Photos and missing sewing models from the old site
post.description: Admin only. A product is found by an old-site SKU (article SKUs of a sewing model, the site article of PPE) or by newModel name; a missing sewing model with newModel is created switched off. Photos are downloaded from baseUrl + path into the Media folder «Старий сайт» (old subfolders kept) and added after the product's own photos; the old main photo becomes main only for a product without photos. dryRun reports and changes nothing; a real run takes at most 20 products, so the admin page sends the file in parts. A repeat adds nothing twice.

get.description: CatalogRead. The PPE product card (CAT-008): supplier fields from the sheet tab «ЗІЗ», Insight XML prices of the current offer version and the live three-tier calculation. Nothing is saved.

put.description: access:products. Replaces the supplier fields. When the supplier price or the rule changes, appends an approved offer version (source «Картка ЗІЗ», server actor/time) that keeps the Insight prices; expectedOfferVersionId must name the current version (null when none).

post.summary: Import PPE supplier prices
post.description: access:price-import. Reads the supplier's files (Insight: 3 XML; СЕМТО: 1 PDF; each may be gzipped) and returns every product of the supplier with old and new prices. dryRun=false saves changed prices as new approved offer versions; manual-price and inactive products are skipped. Request limit 30 MB.

post.summary: Refresh PPE supplier prices
post.description: access:price-import. «Оновити зараз» for a connected website, Google Sheets or dealer cabinet source (av-center, 3c-market, perchatka-centr, trele): reads the supplier's pages, the six 3C lists or the cabinet pages now and returns every product of the supplier with old and new prices. A page without a price or a failed page is a row problem; a 3C list that does not load, or a cabinet login that is missing or refused, fails the request with 400 and changes nothing. The cabinet changes only the dealer price. dryRun=false reads again and saves changed prices as new approved offer versions. File and not yet connected sources answer 400.

get.summary: Get sewing article summary
get.description: Requires CatalogRead. The sewing card in one response (CAT-007, CAT-016). Live calculation of every fabric variant (Article) at server time; nothing is saved; blocked variants return their blockers and no prices. Also returns each variant's fabric with its current name and price per metre, its latest published prices, and the shared composition (materials and operations) with reference names, unit prices and norm minutes. At most 200 Articles.

get.summary: List Articles for a Sewing Product
get.description: Requires CatalogRead. The result is bounded to at most 200 Articles.

post.description: Requires access:products. Creates the variant (Article) with its fabric and metres per product in one transaction (CAT-015). Sale SKU is globally unique, trimmed and compared using ordinal case-sensitive equality.

put.summary: Change a fabric variant
put.description: Requires access:products. Changes the sale SKU, activity and the variant's fabric with metres per product (CAT-015). A stale expectedVersion returns 409.

delete.description: Requires access:products. Removes the variant with its fabric line. A variant that already has saved prices returns 409 and can be switched off instead.

get.summary: Get shared and effective Article composition
get.description: Requires CatalogRead. Returns model-wide lines and shared operations when articleId is omitted. When articleId is supplied, also returns that Article's material lines; the effective materials are model-wide plus Article-scoped, and every material line identifies its scope.

put.summary: Replace model-wide Sewing composition
put.description: Requires access:products. Replaces all model-wide materials and operations atomically. A stale expectedVersion returns 409; clients must not replay automatically and should retain the user's draft for resolution.

post.summary: Save an immutable calculation using server time
post.description: Save an immutable calculation using server time. A request UUID is globally unique; retries return the original snapshot, even after inputs change. Blocked results are saved for diagnosis. Requires access:products.

get.summary: Read an immutable saved result scoped to its Product and Article
get.description: Read an immutable saved result scoped to its Product and Article. Requires CatalogRead.

post.description: Publish an unblocked current calculation. Replaying an already published calculation returns its original publication without replacing the current price. Requires access:products.

get.description: Read the current approved effective settings. Requires CatalogRead.

post.description: Append a complete approved settings revision effective at server time. expectedVersionId must match the latest revision; no partial setting updates. requestId makes retries idempotent. Requires access:pricing-parameters.

get.summary: Get published sewing products
get.description: Requires CatalogRead. Returns active Sewing Products, their active Article count and the latest stored publication per active Article. Missing, inactive and non-Sewing Product IDs are omitted. Empty articles means no published price. No cost or actor data is exposed.

post.description: One-time transfer of the old-site articles with SEO, texts and pictures. An article is matched by its address. With dryRun (the default) nothing is written and the answer says what would happen. Articles that already exist are kept unless overwrite is true. Pictures (the cover and pictures of the text) are downloaded from the old site into the folder «Старий сайт / Статті» of the «Фото» library, each once; a picture that fails is left out and named in problems, the article is still saved. showOnSite switches transferred articles on and never switches one off. Every article is saved on its own, so a repeated run continues where the previous one stopped. Needs the create right.

With dryRun (the default) nothing is written and the answer says what would happen. A new page takes the old address when it is free. Pages that already have texts are kept unless overwrite is true. showOnSite switches transferred pages on and never switches a page off. Needs the create right.

post.description: Transfer of the old-site addresses. Each address goes to the page given in the file (to) or, without it, to the page the server finds - an address under /ru/ is resolved without that prefix and goes to the Russian page; the last part of the address is tried as an article, a site category and the old-site link of a product (its page, or its first site category when it has no page); then the deepest part that is a site category.
